_comment: Tickers only. Add or remove entries here; the daily digest reads this file. Symbols ending in -USD are priced via Coinbase, everything else via Finnhub.

thresholds._comment: A move is flagged when it is unusual for that specific ticker: at least z_score times its own 60-day daily-return standard deviation, and at least min_abs_pct in absolute terms. Any move at or above always_flag_abs_pct is reported regardless -- that ceiling closes the gap where a 7-9% move in a high-volatility name scores under 2 sigma and would otherwise go unreported. Tickers with no price history fall back to fallback_pct. max_shown caps the detailed list; the rest are summarised as a count.
